messages.author: f77d46b4bbd7a974
messages.subject: using ggplot without X11 libraries
parts:
I'm running R on our server without X11 library and headers, it it
possible? I'm having this error while trying to generate the png file.

error:
X11 not available

Are there any alternatives or workaround for this? I'm having hard
time to convince our admin to install X11 library and headers since
they are not included on the default OS installation
